name: Mei Chen
bio: Born in Chengdu, spent 8 years eating through China's back alleys and night markets. Former food writer for Chengdu Evening News. Has eaten at over 300 street stalls across 15 Chinese cities and counting.

name: David Liu
bio: Beijing native and former tour guide who has led food tours through the hutongs since 2018. Knows every jianbing cart and zhajiang mian shop in Dongcheng District.

name: Lina Zhou
bio: Shanghai-based food photographer and dim sum obsessive. Has documented over 100 breakfast stalls across Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Shanghai. Her work has appeared in That's Shanghai and SmartShanghai.
